artists.source_line: Welcome to the 9th edition of #BeyondKizomba, the cultural immersion program in Angola that is designed by Rui Djassi Morácen, the founder of the University of Kizomba initiative, in partnership with – and backed by the logistics support of – Kunanga Life, a legally registered Angolan cultural tourism agency.

Welcome to the 9th edition of #BeyondKizomba, the cultural immersion program in Angola that is designed by Rui Djassi Morácen, the founder of the University of Kizomba initiative, in partnership with – and backed by the logistics support of – Kunanga Life, a legally registered Angolan cultural tourism agency.

features.rationale: The package list states that hotel accommodation is included in the package.

features.quote: Three (3) meals a day (breakfast, lunch, dinner);
features.rationale: The package list states that three meals a day are included.
The package includes airport pick-up and drop-off transfers.

features.quote: ALL group dance classes (incl. kizomba, semba, etc)
features.rationale: Group dance classes are included as part of the package and event program.

features.quote: private classes are booked and paid individually out of pocket
features.rationale: The text says private classes are available to book and pay for individually.
The nightlife program explicitly includes music concerts.
